subcommand_help.run: Generate wiki documentation from a GitHub repository URL or local directory path. Auto-detects URL vs path. If no argument given, uses current directory. Supports options: --name, --token, --output, --include, --exclude, --max-size, --language, --no-cache, --max-abstractions, --mode, --ci, --update, --output-path, --check-changes.
subcommand_help.init: Interactive setup wizard to configure WikiGen for first use. Prompts for LLM provider, API key, output directory, language, and other settings. Saves configuration to disk.
subcommand_help.config: Manage WikiGen configuration. Sub-commands: show (display current config), set <key> <value> (update a config value), update-api-key <provider> (interactively update API key for gemini/openai/anthropic/openrouter), update-github-token [token] (update GitHub personal access token).
subcommand_help.mcp: Start the WikiGen MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. Exposes local wiki markdown files as MCP tools: search_docs (semantic search), get_docs (fetch content by resource name or file path), and index_directories (index dirs for search).
